# `zeroifnull`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns zero if `expr` is equal to null, or `expr` otherwise.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 4.0 and later.

## Syntax

```text
zeroifnull(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `conditional_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- zeroifnull, example 1
> SELECT zeroifnull(NULL);
0
```

```sql
-- zeroifnull, example 2
> SELECT zeroifnull(2);
2
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 4.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
